name: SEO Scout
description: Finds businesses of any type in your cities — or anywhere near you — on Google Maps (read in Isla's browser) or from your own list, works out how each website is built, runs a deep SEO, AEO and GEO audit and measures real page speed. Collects every business's contacts. Saves an HTML report plus CSVs. No API keys and no AI needed.
author: FiveNeurals

settings.label: Business type
settings.help: Anything: dentist, hotel, restaurant, real estate agent, accountant, car repair, school… Empty = any business.

settings.label: Cities
settings.help: Comma separated. Empty = near you. In chat: “seo scout dentists in Colombo and Kandy”.

settings.label: Find on Google Maps (in Isla's browser, no key)
settings.help: Isla opens Google Maps in a private browser window and reads the results: name, phone, address, rating, reviews, website.

settings.label: Show the browser while it works
Also find with AI web research
settings.help: Uses one task of your AI agent per run.

settings.label: Always check these sites
settings.help: One per line: URL | City | Name (City and Name optional).

settings.label: Measure real page speed
settings.help: Loads each site fresh in Isla's browser at phone size: LCP, CLS, FCP, load time, page weight.

settings.label: Add AI-written insights
settings.help: The report always has rule-based findings; this adds an AI summary on top.

settings.label: Google API key (optional, advanced)
settings.help: Not needed. If you add one (Places API (New) + PageSpeed Insights API), Isla uses Google's official APIs instead of the browser and adds Lighthouse scores. Stored encrypted.

settings.label: Brave Search API key (optional, advanced)
settings.help: Not needed. Adds web-search discovery and finds websites for map listings that have none. Stored encrypted.

tools.title: Find businesses & audit their websites
tools.description: Finds businesses per city (or near you) on Google Maps, crawls each website, runs 75+ SEO / AEO / GEO checks, measures real speed, collects contacts, and saves report.html + sites.csv + contacts.csv + checks.csv.
